decisions.reason: The single emailable PDF is the final submission artifact and does not cancel or alter the separately required editable Canva source access.
The same message already records the fixed section order for this Requirement; PDF file count, email submission, and export optimization belong to the separate final-export Requirement.
The PDF export and email-submission decision does not change which tables must be integrated or how the supplied tables are treated.
The source decision does not change or remove the requirement to integrate photos into the proposal.
The same message already records the fixed section order for this Requirement, while the one-PDF email-delivery constraint does not alter narrative content integration.
The final PDF export and submission method do not change the Agua Arc identity or brand assets to be applied.
The source specifies the final artifact and submission channel but does not change any draft, revision, or submission date in the delivery schedule.
The source decision concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ and has no effect on the TPEC proposal design.
The final PDF format and email-submission method do not change the permitted revision-round count.
The source decision does not change the anticipated page count or establish a new page-limit constraint.
